title: Buyer and seller value from optional automated bargaining in electronic commerce: reproducibility materials
description:
Code, data and documentation supporting the manuscript Buyer and seller value from optional automated bargaining in electronic commerce by Bankatesh Choudhary and Meenakshi Sharma.

Includes the original AmazonHistoryPrice (Apache-2.0) and CaSiNo (CC BY 4.0) source files, cleaned numerical tables, variable definitions and transformations, analysis, simulation and figure-generation code, frozen fitted Q iteration checkpoints, saved synthetic negotiation outcomes, sensitivity results, checksums and a review guide (review_support/REVIEW_GUIDE.txt).

The CraigslistBargain corpus (He et al., 2018) is not redistributed because its maintainers state no data licence. Scripts in review_support/ download the exact files from the original CodaLab endpoints, accept them only if their SHA-256 checksums match the study record, and regenerate all 15 withheld Craigslist-derived files.

Author code is released under the MIT licence and author-generated data under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA.md). Simulated outcomes are not observations of real customers.
